alpha_duplicate_class.duplicate_watch: max trade overlap >= 0.30 or abs(corr) >= 0.80, but not enough to reject automatically.
alpha_duplicate_class.likely_duplicate: max trade overlap >= 0.50 OR abs(corr) >= 0.80 AND max trade overlap >= 0.30.
alpha_duplicate_class.not_duplicate: max trade overlap < 0.30 and abs(corr) < 0.80, unless stronger duplicate rule triggers.

classification_policy.correlation_note: High daily correlation alone is cluster-weighting evidence, not automatic rejection evidence.
classification_policy.loss_day_overlap_note: Loss-day overlap is a stress/risk warning only. It does not force duplicate/redundant classification.

portfolio_decision.keep_but_cluster_weight: High or moderate correlation cluster; keep for HRP/allocator cluster weighting, not deletion.
portfolio_decision.keep_with_stress_risk_warning: Low duplicate risk but high same-loss-day stress overlap.
portfolio_decision.manual_review_before_accept: Crowded overlap or very high correlation without enough evidence to auto-reject.
portfolio_decision.reject_or_merge_candidate: Likely duplicate based on high overlap, or high correlation plus crowded overlap.

notes: Duplicate rejection is based mainly on trade overlap, or high correlation plus crowded overlap.
High correlation without high overlap is reported as correlation_cluster_class and should be handled by HRP/allocator/risk caps.
Same-loss-day overlap is reported as stress_overlap_class and loss_overlap_warning, not as alpha duplication.
research_events mode is candidate-opportunity overlap only, not deployability evidence.
scored_candidates or selected_trades with --threshold-policy override --probability-threshold 0.10 can reveal overlap hidden by selected deployable thresholds.
This lab consumes artifacts only; it does not score models or engineer edge features.

threshold_policy_notes.all: selected_trades/scored_candidates ignores probability thresholds and loads all scored rows with R values.
threshold_policy_notes.override: selected_trades/scored_candidates uses the supplied probability threshold for every edge, e.g. 0.10.
threshold_policy_notes.research_events: research_events ignores probability thresholds and uses exported research model rows.
threshold_policy_notes.selected: selected_trades uses each edge's selected threshold artifact.
